title: Persistent operator signing key: keygen and storage
description:
Persist the operator signing key across restarts so article signatures remain verifiable.

Why this issue exists:
The signing key is currently regenerated on every startup, making all previously signed articles unverifiable after a restart. A stable key must be generated once, stored on disk, and loaded on subsequent starts.

What needs to be done:
- keygen subcommand for transit and reader (generates and saves a raw 32-byte ed25519 seed)
- Unify key file format to raw 32 bytes across both daemons
- Deterministic HLC node_id derived from signing key so it is also stable across restarts
- Enforce signing_key_path on non-loopback bind (refuse to start without a key file)
- RUNBOOK.md key generation and backup instructions
